question: With which of the following gharanas is Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patiala gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a renowned Indian classical vocalist associated with the **Patiala gharana**.
 
• He was born on April 2, 1902, in Kasur, Punjab (now in Pakistan).
 
• His contribution to Hindustani classical music is immense, and he is celebrated for his unique style of singing.
 
• He was known for his powerful and emotive voice, which could span three octaves effortlessly.
 
• Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was also honored with the title of **Sangeet Samrat** (Emperor of Music).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patiala Gharana**

 
 
• Founded in the mid-19th century by Ustad Fateh Ali Khan and Ustad Ali Baksh Khan.
 
• Known for its elaborate and intricate taans (rapid melodic passages).
 
• The gharana emphasizes the importance of a powerful voice and the use of intricate ornamentations in their singing.
 
• It has significantly influenced other gharanas and modern Hindustani classical music.
 
 
 
• **Gharana**
 
 
• It refers to a distinctive style of Indian classical music that is passed down through generations.
 
• Each gharana has its own unique techniques, compositions, and interpretations of ragas.
 
• Prominent gharanas include Gwalior, Agra, Kirana, and Jaipur-Atrauli, among others.
 
• The concept of gharanas is more prominent in Hindustani classical music than in Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani Classical Music**
 
 
• One of the two major traditions of Indian classical music, the other being Carnatic music.
 
• Originated in North India and has a rich history of over a thousand years.
 
• It includes various forms such as Khayal, Dhrupad, Thumri, and Tappa.
 
• Prominent instruments used in Hindustani music include the sitar, sarod, tabla, and harmonium.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan's Legacy**
 
 
• He left behind a rich legacy of recordings that continue to inspire musicians and music lovers.
 
• His students and followers have carried forward his style and teachings.
 
• His contribution to the popularization of Hindustani classical music is unparalleled.
 
• He received numerous accolades and recognition for his artistry, including the Padma Bhushan in 1962.
